subject: Urgent: HeliosAI throughput & error settlement — exec briefing requested
messages:
From: Elaine Cortez <elaine.cortez@heliosai.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: ops@heliosai.com
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: High tail latency & error spike impacting nightly billing runs

Hi Vanessa,

We observed a sustained tail-latency degradation and a spike in 5xx errors across the inference tier between 02:00–06:30 UTC on 2026-10-25. That window impacted our nightly billing job throughput (we saw retries and missed invoices). Our SLO per Appendix B of the contract is 99.9% p95 latency and <0.5% 5xx rate; during the incident p95 slipped to ~820ms (target 150ms) and 5xx hit 2.8%.

This has direct revenue impact for HeliosAI (estimated ~ $48k lost recurring revenue this month) and we need an agreed commercial settlement plus assurance this won’t recur. Please escalate to your execs — we need:
- A timeline of root cause and remediation plan
- A commercial remediation (credits/refund) proposal we can present to our CFO
- Confirmation of steps to prevent recurrence (capacity, throttling, fallback)

We’re attaching a small set of traces and the billing job logs. Can you confirm receipt and propose times for an executive-level call this week?

Thanks,
Elaine Cortez
Head of Ops, HeliosAI
attachments: support-log-20261025.zip

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Cortez <elaine.cortez@heliosai.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 18:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High tail latency & error spike impacting nightly billing runs

Elaine — thank you for the detailed summary and the logs. I’m very sorry for the disruption and I appreciate the impact framing. I’ve looped in Sean (account lead) and Monica (Customer Success) and we will triage immediately.

Immediate next steps we’re kicking off:
- Our SREs are analyzing the KV-cache eviction patterns and autoscaler logs (initial signs point to a burst of heavy long-sequence requests that crowded dedicated pool).
- We’ll produce a root-cause timeline within 48 hours and a mitigation plan (short-term: temporary pool burst and query shaping; mid-term: routing policy tweaks + quota protections).
- Commercial: Sean will propose a settlement range for your CFO; we want to be responsive and fair.

Can you confirm the magnitude of the billing job failures (count of failed invoices) and a contact on your side for finance? I’ll also prepare an exec-brief for our COO and Head of Revenue.

Proposed call slots (PST): Tue 10/27 09:00–10:00, 11:30–12:30, Wed 10/28 14:00–15:00 — please confirm what works.

—Vanessa
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High tail latency & error spike impacting nightly billing runs

Vanessa / Monica —
Agree we need an immediate commercial posture. A few quick facts from my side:
- HeliosAI is on a committed Dedicated plan (monthly commit: $120k) with SLA Appendix B.
- The contract language gives us a credit formula tied to "sustained degradation" windows; historically we’ve offered 10–20% monthly credit depending on impact.

I propose we come to the call with two options for Helios to choose from:
A) Balance-of-month pro-rated credit of 15% + 30% discount on next month's overage charges.
B) One-time invoice credit of $25k + technical remediation commitment (2-week prioritized runbook and weekly transparency calls).

Both require exec sign-off (COO/Revenue) — I will prep a one-page term sheet and run it by Rishi for approvals. We should also be ready to offer a short-term capacity bump (covered by Redwood) while we finalize the fix.

—Sean

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 15:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High tail latency & error spike impacting nightly billing runs

Team — quick internal note before the call:
- Risk appetite: high for a one-time credit + remediation (we want to preserve relationship and avoid churn).
- Approval: I can clear up to $30k one-time credit without Legal. Anything above or a contract amendment needs Legal/Revenue Ops review.
- Suggested preferred offer: Option B (one-time $25k credit) + a 60-day remediation SLA (formalized runbook + postmortem) + a commitment to onboard a second region routing fallback by EOM Nov.

Please ensure the proposed term sheet explicitly references the impacted window (2026-10-25 02:00–06:30 UTC) and the measured metrics (p95 / 5xx). I do not want to promise credits that exceed my sign-off.

Rishi
Senior Director, Commercial Ops

From: Elaine Cortez <elaine.cortez@helioai.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: ops@helioai.com
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High tail latency & error spike impacting nightly billing runs

Vanessa / Sean — thank you for the quick internal alignment. A few clarifications from Helios:
- Our finance lead (Marco Reyes, marco.reyes@heliosai.com) will need the credit proposal in writing and a line-item to reconcile against our disputed invoice for Oct.
- We accept a one-time credit, but we require a written remediation timeline and a commitment to a 30-minute exec check-in after the postmortem.
- Helios is open to Option B provided we get: (1) $25k one-time credit (2) prioritized remediation and (3) DocuSign-ready term sheet by EOD Wed 10/28.

Can you attach the proposed term sheet and the SRE preliminary timeline to the DocSend link when ready? We will escalate internally if that timeline slips.

Thanks,
Elaine

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Cortez <elaine.cortez@helioai.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High tail latency & error spike impacting nightly billing runs — term sheet and exec call

Elaine — I appreciate the clarity and the timeline. Short update: 
- Attached: proposed-settlement-term-sheet.pdf (one-time credit $25,000, references impacted window and metrics), and helios-service-impact-summary-2026-10-25.pdf (SRE preliminary findings).
- We confirm the remediation commitments: 60-day prioritized runbook, weekly status emails, and an architecture change to introduce an additional routing fallback region by 2026-11-30.
- DocSend link (term sheet + SRE summary): https://docsend.com/view/helios-settlement-draft

We have a confirmed exec slot: Wed 10/28 14:00–14:30 PST (Vanessa, Sean, Monica; Helios execs to join: Elaine + Marco). Call invite to follow. After the call, we will issue the DocuSign-ready amendment reflecting the $25k credit and the remediation milestones.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed-settlement-term-sheet.pdf, helios-service-impact-summary-2026-10-25.pdf
